name: Narviko paper-to-live matcher
description: Match every live broker fill to its planned (paper) leg on instrument, planned qty and time; flag short or missing legs; attribute the Rs gap only on matched rows.

status.manual: Run by hand on 2 traders, 14 Sep 2026 (Excel). See evidence/09-process-map.md
status.automated: Planned, v1 weeks 2-3. Not built yet.

inputs.source: Trader's bot planned orders / paper book export

steps.name: ingest
steps.do: Load tradebook and planned orders. Read-only. No broker access.

steps.name: validate
steps.do: Reject rows without symbol, qty or timestamp. Check one session only. Recompute qty x (price - entry) per row against the trader's total.
steps.why: Trader A: no per-leg paper price. Trader B: no timestamps, expiries across 9 months.

steps.name: match
steps.do: For each planned leg find live fills with same tradingsymbol and side, fill time within match_window_seconds of signal_time. Sum filled qty per leg.
steps.note: Bottleneck step (#5 in process map). Everything after depends on it.

steps.name: leg_check
steps.do: Per structure_id compare planned_qty vs filled_qty per leg. Flag short or missing legs immediately.
steps.example: Trader A, NIFTY: 5 short lots vs 1 long lot per side -> 4 lots unhedged, unnoticed.

steps.name: slippage
steps.do: Only on matched rows: slippage_rs = (fill_price - planned_price) x qty x side_sign; bps = slippage_rs / (planned_price x qty) x 10000; latency_ms = fill_time - signal_time.

steps.name: attribute
steps.do: Tag each gap row with one cause. unmatched_plan -> missed-fill; short leg -> partial-leg; matched -> slippage or timing; anything else -> unexplained.

steps.name: score
steps.do: attributed_pct = sum(|gap| rows with cause != unexplained) / sum(|gap| all rows) x 100. Gross gap, not net, so causes cannot cancel.

steps.name: report
steps.do: One page per session: leg flags first, then Rs gap by cause, then unexplained rows. Every line traces to a contract note.

steps.name: review
steps.do: Send to trader. Ask: planned or mistake? What would you change? No leading questions.

measured_results.decision_changed: Check all legs match expected qty before adding real money
Fix futures price source first; if gap is real, change order type or entry logic

falsifier: If data has timestamps and planned qty and attributed_pct is still below 50, OR the next 2 traders say a leg mismatch has never happened to them, version C is wrong.
